First release of Audio Lens Seekbar for foobar2000 2.x (Default UI and Columns UI, 64 and 32 bit,
Windows 10/11).

**Install:** download `foo_audiolens-1.0.0.fb2k-component` below, double-click it (or *Preferences →
Components → Install…*), restart foobar2000 and add *Audio Lens Seekbar* to your layout.

**Highlights**
- Spectrogram, waveform, live spectrum and loudness heatmap as a clickable seekbar
- Up to four metric curves and 17 values, loudness per ITU-R BS.1770 / EBU R128 (122/122 checks of the EBU and
  ITU test material), DR per the TT DR algorithm
- Optional quality report (fake hi-res, lossy source, fake bit depth, clipping …)
- Multichannel / Atmos channel beds, zoom, fullscreen, export, presets, 19 themes

See the [changelog](https://github.com/Oxensepp/audiolens-seekbar/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) for the full list.
